visual-meaning-archive-early.json.scope: All78 source pages in lecture01–04 were reviewed against sourceText, existing page inventories and Original C Version2. Patches replace only teaching on pages where meaningful visual notation or comparison needed clarification. Unmapped pages inherit Version2 unchanged.
visual-meaning-archive-early.json.visualInspection: All78 static slide previews inspected in contact sheets; key tables, vector diagrams, SGD plots and Bellman network/equation pages inspected at full1600px slide resolution. Existing original visual assets are retained.
limitations: No raw Module I verbal transcript was available. Evidence uses the supplied slides, source extraction, retained inventories and existing source-grounded teaching.
Static preview review does not establish animation or audio coverage. No unseen animation or audio behavior is asserted.
visual-meaning-archive-early.json.approach: Explain what displayed values, indices, colors, arrows, axes, reference conditions and symbols mean in the actual source example. Preserve readable explanatory bullets and sub-bullets without calculation recitals, fixed counts or repeated labels.

visual-meaning-archive-late.json.scope: All 77 source pages in lecture05-06 and lectures07–10 were compared with C2. Only pages with meaningful unexplained visual notation receive replacement teaching. Empty title, blank and logistical pages retain C2.
visual-meaning-archive-late.json.inspection: Existing all-page contact sheets were reviewed; detailed source slides/native speaker notes and page-inventory OCR were checked for equations, labels and ordered animation states. Original magnesium and learning-rate figures were read at full available resolution. Air-spacing, cosine, combined-frequency and cycle-count media were sampled at six time positions during C2 review, and those reviewed frames were rechecked for scales and labels.
limitations: Sampling establishes the inspected states rather than full frame-by-frame animation or audio coverage. Original source media remain available.
No raw verbal transcript is available for these Module I pages; no additional spoken emphasis is claimed.
The hearing mechanism uses supplied notes-lecture07 pages8–9 and15 because the primary hearing pages have headings/labels rather than a complete embedded animation.

Brain-area abbreviations are identified as source diagram names without inventing unprovided functions for every area. Historical dates, decorative score details and title-page metadata do not become memorization lists.
Approximation and linear-network corrections follow the supplied source notes and existing source issues rather than silently treating flattened overlay numbers as complete coherent computations.
visual-meaning-archive-late.json.terminologyPreference: Name the system, motion, mode or pattern directly. Use model or distribution where appropriate, and image/image patch for literal visual inputs. Avoid picture as a substitute for the subject.

visual-meaning-physics.json.scope: Reviewed all61 source pages of Lectures11–13 against Original C Version2. Patches supply complete replacement teaching blocks; unpatched pages inherit that edition without alteration.
visual-meaning-physics.json.visualReview: All static source-page contact sheets and selected full-size figure panels were inspected. The15 distinct embedded videos were checked through frames at12%,47% and79% of duration during the preceding source review, and their original image assets and visible labels were rechecked for this edition. This is sampled visual review, not complete animation or audio playback. The harmonics/formants GIF has one frame and was inspected as a still image.
visual-meaning-physics.json.meaningfulValues: Retains values that identify a condition, location, axis, relative rate or resonance/source distinction. Does not recite every footnote ratio, playback setting or frequency label, and adds no worked calculation.
visual-meaning-physics.json.sourceCorrections: The printed L12 stiffness-down arrow remains untouched in the source visual and is explained as a typo in the new teaching. Membrane frequency values remain identified as assigned illustration settings rather than natural rectangle resonances.
visual-meaning-physics.json.terminologyPreference: Name the system, motion, mode or pattern directly. Use model or distribution where appropriate, and image/image patch for literal visual inputs. Avoid picture as a substitute for the subject.

visual-meaning-ai.json.scope: All70sourcepages in Lectures14–18 reviewed against C2, sourceText, speakerNotes, original previews and supplied transcript evidence. Only new V3 teaching replacements are supplied; unmapped pages inherit C2. No previous edition or UI file is changed.
visual-meaning-ai.json.staticReview: All70previews inspected in collection contact sheets, with32targeted full-size diagram/code/plot previews inspected for exact identifiers, axes, legends, numerical roles and repeated-number ambiguities.
visual-meaning-ai.json.mediaReview: Three sampled frames at8%,45%and82%of each of8unique original L14videos inspected. Frame sampling supports the visible labels, positions and representative states; it is not full animation/audio inspection. Existing source transcript and inventories supply movement explanations.
visual-meaning-ai.json.knownSourceIssue: L14p23 subtitle calls negative weights orange, while the visible negative labels are green. V3 explains the signed values and actual connection positions without teaching that inconsistent color rule.
visual-meaning-ai.json.teachingStyle: Identifiers are defined inside their conceptual explanation; no detached glossary, repeated labels, fixed bullet count, outside theory, class narration, or worked arithmetic.
visual-meaning-ai.json.trainingCurveProvenance: The L16p15–16 source figures show executed NumPy reference runs alongside requested PyTorch code. This construction distinction is retained here rather than inserted into spoken teaching. Teaching retains the actual graph conditions:525trainingexamples,full-batchupdates,randominitializations,seeds0–9,2,000updates,learningrate0.1and44.95%finaltrainingaccuracy.
visual-meaning-ai.json.terminologyPreference: Name the system, motion, mode or pattern directly. Use model or distribution where appropriate, and image/image patch for literal visual inputs. Avoid picture as a substitute for the subject.
